definitions.explanation: A novelist known for confessional, self-destructive fiction, above all {人間失格|にんげんしっかく} (No Longer Human) and {斜陽|しゃよう} (The Setting Sun). His troubled life — repeated suicide attempts and eventual death by drowning at 38 — colors how his books are read, and his work remains a favorite among alienated young readers.

Usually called {太宰|だざい} (the family name) in casual reference.

- {太宰|だざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read Dazai

CULTURAL NOTE:
His novel {人間失格|にんげんしっかく} (No Longer Human) — a confession of shame and alienation — remains one of the best-selling classics of modern Japanese literature, especially among teenagers and young adults who identify with its narrator. He drowned himself in the {玉川上水|たまがわじょうすい} canal in Tokyo at 38, after several earlier suicide attempts.
